results.name: Rusty Nuclear Waste Barrel – Game Ready 3D Asset
results.description:
**Rusty Nuclear Waste Barrel – Game Ready 3D Asset**

A detailed and realistic rusty industrial barrel designed for games, environments, cinematics, animations and 3D visualization.

The model features a heavily weathered metal surface with realistic rust, scratches, dirt and worn paint. A radiation warning symbol adds an authentic hazardous-waste aesthetic, making this prop ideal for nuclear facilities, abandoned industrial areas, post-apocalyptic environments and survival games.

**Features:**
• Detailed weathered metal surface
• Rust, dirt and scratches
• Worn industrial paint
• Radiation warning symbol
• PBR textures
• UV unwrapped
• Ideal for games and real-time environments
• Suitable for industrial and post-apocalyptic scenes

A versatile environment prop designed to add realism and atmosphere to industrial and abandoned environments.

results.name: Barrel Pack - Low Poly Props
results.description:
A comprehensive game-ready asset pack containing 5 unique low-poly industrial metal barrels. Includes various post-apocalyptic and hazard variants: classic rusty, biohazard, old grunge, radiation warning, and bright yellow toxic waste drum. Perfect for FPS shooters, survival horror levels, warehouses, or sci-fi environments.

Features:
- Pack of 5 unique photo-textured models
- Optimized Low-Poly geometry with 3D structural ridges
- Various hazard and apocalyptic themes (Biohazard, Radiation, Toxic)
- Made in Blender 3.6
- Format: FBX (with embedded textures)

---
Ультимативный игровой пак из 5 уникальных низкополигональных металлических бочек. Включает различные индустриальные варианты и знаки опасности: классическая ржавая, биологическая угроза, старая заброшенная, радиация и желтая бочка с токсичными отходами. results.name: Rusty Metal Barrel - Inspired Industrial Prop

Features a custom teal/blue-green worn paint texture with realistic rust patches. Ideal for shooters, post-apocalyptic levels, warehouses, or sci-fi environments.

Features:

- Worn industrial photo-textured look (Teal & Rust)
- Made in Blender 3.6
- Format: FBX (with embedded textures)

---
Лоу-поли 3D-модель ржавой металлической бочки, вдохновленная культовыми промышленными пропами из Half-Life 2. Текстура сине-зеленой облупившейся краски с реалистичными пятнами ржавчины. Отличный базовый ассет для шутеров, постапокалиптических локаций, складов и индустриальных зон. Создано в Blender 3.6.

results.name: Realistic Wooden Barrel (Game Ready 3D Asset)
results.description:
3D barrel asset created using a complete production pipeline. Modeled in Autodesk Maya, sculpted in ZBrush, and textured using Substance 3D Painter with additional material refinement in Substance 3D Sampler. Final asset prepared and rendered in Unreal Engine.

Designed with attention to realistic wood and metal surface detail, clean topology, and real-time rendering optimization.

results.name: oil dram
results.description:
Rusty Oil Drum – 3D Prop Asset

A realistic industrial oil drum created from scratch using a complete 3D workflow. The asset features detailed rust buildup, worn paint, scratches, and weathering effects to achieve an aged and believable appearance. The model was carefully UV unwrapped and textured using a PBR workflow to create realistic material response and surface variation.

This project was created as a game-ready prop suitable for industrial, post-apocalyptic, warehouse, and environment scenes.
